typography.hook: editorial display Cyrillic (didone or refined geometric grotesque, normal tracking); in-frame, not sticker

global_prompt_prefix: High-key light studio. WHITE #FFFFFF, ink #141821, medallion gold #C4A574, dusty summer tones. Cover hero: Victoria from victoria-sheet.png ONLY LARGE left, same woman same eyes, eyes green with a slight brown/hazel tint not brown not grey, hair color copied exactly from reference photo, same root depth, do not lighten, no platinum, new outfit+emotion, NEVER a cat, NEVER faceless, NEVER default white hoodie. Hook type: editorial display Cyrillic (high-contrast modern serif/didone OR refined geometric grotesque, normal tracking); letters are part of the frame, not a sticker. One punch word same face, gold. Sticky/labels: light humanist sans. Ban Arial/Roboto/Inter/Impact/Times/bold condensed/squish-bold/all-caps plaque. Thin white gutters at x=1024 y=576.
inline_prompt_suffix: Inline all: white #FFFFFF, lighter designer humanist sans Cyrillic labels (3–6), medallion gold accent only; NO people/faces/host/Alyona/cat; no cover-hook duplicate; no bold condensed; no all-caps sticker plaque. Neg: candles, gothic, pink-cat, #FF1493, Arial, Roboto, Inter, Impact, beige full-panel, unfinished gray boxes, watermark, 9:16.
rebuild_rule: Wrong face vs victoria-sheet.png, wrong eyes (not green+hazel), platinum/lighter-than-ref hair, crooked seam, crooked letters → rebuild the whole 2K 2×2 canvas. Do not fix face, eyes, hair, or type outside the canvas. Do not publish — Hall publishes.
comment: Tenant preset. Do not fall back to pink-cat collage or bold condensed Cyrillic.
